seo.title: Yasawa Princess II: Blue Lagoon Cruises' 44-Guest Ship in Fiji's Yasawas | James Wild & Co
seo.description: MV Yasawa Princess II, new in 2026, carries 44 guests in 22 cabins on 3, 4 and 7-night cruises from Port Denarau through the Yasawa Islands, with the Blue Lagoon, the Sawa-i-Lau caves and manta rays. Adults only from mid-January 2027.

tagline: Forty-four guests, the Yasawa Islands, and a ship small enough to tie up to a coconut tree.
answer: MV Yasawa Princess II is Blue Lagoon Cruises' small ship in Fiji, new to the fleet in 2026: 45.8 metres, 22 cabins and at most 44 guests, with up to 22 Fijian crew. She sails 3, 4 and 7-night cruises from Port Denarau through the Mamanuca and Yasawa Islands, to the Sacred Islands, the Blue Lagoon, the Sawa-i-Lau caves and the manta rays of Drawaqa. Blue Lagoon Cruises becomes adults only (16 and over) from mid-January 2027.
facts: 22: 20 Orchid and 2 Hibiscus, all about 14.5 sq m
overview: Yasawa Princess II joined Blue Lagoon Cruises in 2026. At 45.8 metres she reaches bays a larger ship cannot, close enough to tie off to a coconut tree so guests can swim to the beach. Blue Lagoon Cruises has sailed these islands for more than 75 years.

She carries at most 44 guests with up to 22 Fijian crew. On board: an air-conditioned dining room, lounge and bar, an open Sun Deck for evening dining, a spa for massages, a small library, snorkelling gear, kayaks and paddle boards, free satellite Wi-Fi, and a hydraulic platform at the stern that makes boarding the tenders easier.

Days follow a gentle rhythm, with at most four hours of cruising a day: villages and a kava ceremony, the private beach on Nanuya Lailai in the Blue Lagoon, the Sawa-i-Lau caves, and from May to October the manta rays at Drawaqa. The itinerary is flexible, moving to the sheltered side of the islands when the weather asks.
why: Small enough for the Yasawas: 44 guests, and a ship that ties up to a coconut tree.

faqs: How many guests does Yasawa Princess II carry?
At most 44, in 22 cabins, with up to 22 Fijian crew.
Where does Yasawa Princess II sail?
Through Fiji's Mamanuca and Yasawa Islands from Port Denarau: the Sacred Islands, Soso, the Blue Lagoon at Nanuya Lailai, the Sawa-i-Lau caves and Drawaqa.
3, 4 or 7 nights. The 7-night Escape to Paradise leaves every Friday; the 4-night Wanderer every Monday; the 3-night Explorer every Friday.
Is Blue Lagoon Cruises adults only?
Yes from mid-January 2027: every departure is for guests 16 and over.
When can you swim with manta rays?
From May to October at Drawaqa, tide dependent, on the 4 and 7-night cruises.
All meals, tea and coffee, a stocked mini bar on departure day, the Captain's Dinners, every scheduled activity, laundry, Wi-Fi and hotel transfers in Denarau and Nadi.
Can I join from a Mamanuca resort?
Yes. Blue Lagoon Cruises runs transfers from the Mamanuca resorts, including Likuliku, Castaway and Tokoriki.
